description: This test file contains unit tests for a FastAPI application, verifying endpoint behavior, OpenAPI schema generation, and the client test setup. It tests path and query parameter handling, as well as the generated OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: TestClient
classes.description: A test client class provided by fastapi.testclient to simulate HTTP requests to the FastAPI app.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports the FastAPI app module based on the parameter and returns a TestClient instance.

methods.name: test_read_user_item(client: TestClient, path, expected_json)
methods.description: Parameterized test function that sends GET requests to item endpoints and verifies the response JSON matches expectations.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that the /openapi.json endpoint returns the expected OpenAPI schema.
